subject: Risk & Compliance
title: The Eurozone Debt Crisis
description: Learn The Eurozone Debt Crisis in one minute.

hook.text: Five eurozone countries — Greece, Ireland, Portugal, Spain, Cyprus — needed bailouts. The euro nearly fractured.

buildup.text: The eurozone crisis (2010-2015) revealed that shared currency without shared fiscal policy creates fragility.

discovery.text: The ECB's 'whatever it takes' moment in 2012 — Mario Draghi's speech — is credited with saving the eurozone.

twist.text: Austerity imposed on crisis countries deepened recessions and caused social unrest that reshapes politics to this day.

climax.text: The eurozone survived but remains structurally vulnerable. The next crisis will test whether the fixes were enough.

punchline.text: Five bailouts. One currency. 'Whatever it takes' saved it.

quiz.question: What is credited with saving the eurozone in 2012?
options: Mario Draghi's 'whatever it takes' speech committing ECB support
All countries adopting the same fiscal policy
